info.title: wav API
info.description: API for retrieving conversion details by ID.

get.description: Retrieve details of a conversion using `task_id` or `conversion_id`.

parameters.name: conversionType
parameters.description: The type of Conversion you want to get your details from.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description:
Task ID associated with the conversion. 
 **Note:** You must provide either `task_id` or `conversion_id`, but not both.

parameters.name: conversion_id
parameters.description:
Conversion ID to fetch details. 
 **Note:** You must provide either `task_id` or `conversion_id`, but not both.

get.description: Search for voices to get their voice ID by their names using a query string.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search string to filter voices by name

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of voices per page

get.description: Fetch all available voices with their IDs.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of voices per page

post.summary: Generate Custom Music
post.description: Create music powered by AI using just a prompt, lyrics, or a defined music style.

prompt.description: A natural language prompt for music generation. Keep it under 1000 characters. Be clear and descriptive for better results.

music_style.description: Style of music to generate (e.g., Rock, Pop)

lyrics.description: Custom lyrics for the generated music

title.description: Title of the generated music track

make_instrumental.description: Whether to make the music instrumental

vocal_only.description: Whether to generate only vocals of output audio

voice_id.description: Voice model to convert generated audio

generate_album_cover.description: Whether to generate an album cover for the generated audio

webhook_url.description: URL for callback upon completion

post.summary: Convert voice from audio file or URL
post.description: Convert the voice from an audio file or URL to a different voice.

audio_url.description: Input audio URL (supported format: YouTube URL).

remove_background.description: 1 to remove background noise, 0 to keep

webhook_url.description: Callback URL

example.error: The file could not be downloaded from the provided URL
Both audio_url and audio_file cannot be None

x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

url = "https://api.wav.com/api/public/v1/VoiceChanger"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "<API_KEY>"
}

data = {
    "voice_id": "e0bb585f-b798-4bac-ac4e-de7fff38f9d75",
    "remove_background": 1,
    "pitch": 0,
    "webhook_url": "https://example.com/my-webhook"
}

# Option 1: audio_url
data["audio_url"] = "<YOUR_AUDIO_URL>"
response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=data)

# Option 2: File Upload
# with open("song.mp3", "rb") as f:
#     files = {"audio_file": f}
#     response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=data, files=files)

print(response.json())

post.summary: Convert audio to cover song
post.description: Convert an audio file or URL into a cover song using a different voice.

audio_url.description: Input audio URL (supported format: YouTube URL).

audio_file.description: Audio file to upload and process. Either audio_file or audio_url must be provided.

voice_id.description: The ID of the voice model to use for voice transformation.

pitch.description: Pitch adjustment for the voice. Range from -12 to 12. Default: 0

webhook_url.description: A URL where the result will be sent once processing is completed.

example.error: The file could not be downloaded from the provided URL
Both audio_url and audio_file cannot be None

post.summary: Convert text to speech using a specified voice
post.description:
Synthesize speech from text with voice and gender customization, plus optional webhook callback.  
Give priority to the sample audio first, then to the voice ID, and lastly to gender.

text.example: Hello, this is a sample text to speech conversion.

sample_audio_url.description: An audio URL containing a voice sample of the target speaker without music or overlapping voices. Recommended over voice_id for better output quality.

webhook_url.description: Callback URL for async processing

post.summary: Extract stems from an audio file or URL
post.description: Process an audio file to extract specified stems (vocals, instrumental, or other components) with optional preprocessing. Supports file upload or URL with webhook callback.

audio_url.description: Input audio URL (supported format: YouTube URL).

audio_file.description: Audio file to upload and process.

stems.description: JSON string list of required output stems. Available options: vocals, instrumental, male_vocal, female_vocal, lead_vocal, back_vocal, bass, drums, guitar, piano, keys, strings, winds, rhythm_guitar, solo_guitar, acoustic_guitar, electric_guitar, kick_drum, snare_drum, toms, hi_hat, ride, crash.

preprocessing_options.description: JSON string list of preprocessing steps. Available options: Denoise, Deecho, Dereverb.

eco_mode.description: Enable eco mode for faster parallel extraction.

webhook_url.description: Callback URL for async processing.

message.example: Either audio_url or audio_file must be provided.

post.summary: Inpaint an Audio Segment
post.description:
This endpoint allows users to replace a specific time segment of an audio clip using a textual prompt and optional lyrics. The inpainting operation blends new audio content into the selected range, guided by user-defined style and voice preferences.  

To use the inpaint feature, upload a song and specify the lyrics you want to replace in the field **'lyrics_section_to_replace'**. For best results, also provide the complete song lyrics in the **lyrics**.

audio_url.description: Input audio URL (supported format: YouTube URL).

prompt.description: A description of how the replacement should sound.
prompt.example: Replace this part with an opera-style vocal.

replace_start_at.description: Time in seconds to start replacing audio.

replace_end_at.description: Time in seconds to stop replacing audio.

lyrics.description: Lyrics to be used for inpainting.
lyrics.example: This is where my story begins

lyrics_section_to_replace.description: Lyrics to be used for the replaced portion(optional, max 3000 characters)

gender.description: Voice style for the inpainted segment.

num_outputs.description: The number of outputs to generate (1 or 2 only):default is 2.

title.description: Title of the generated music track

generate_album_cover.description: Whether to generate an album cover for the generated audio

lyrics_timestamps.description: Whether to generate timestamps for the lyrics

webhook_url.description: Callback URL for async processing results.

message.example: audio_file or audio_url and valid replace range are required.

get.description: This endpoint takes a natural language prompt (e.g., a theme, vibe, or idea) and generates original lyrics based on it. If the prompt has been used before, a variation may be returned. It also estimates the credit cost of generation.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The theme or idea you'd like lyrics generated for.

schema.example: A hopeful song about starting over

example.lyrics:
Under the silver moonlight we sway...
...

error.example: Prompt must be between 1 and 1000 characters.

500.description: Internal server error during lyrics generation

post.summary: Generate Image Based on Given Prompt
post.description: Creates an AI-generated image from a text prompt and optional style settings. The generation process is asynchronous and returns a task ID for tracking.

prompt.description: Text prompt guiding the image generation.
prompt.example: A futuristic cyberpunk city at sunset with flying cars.

height.description: Image height in pixels. Must be a multiple of 16.

width.description: Image width in pixels. Must be a multiple of 16.

seed.description: Deterministic generation seed. Randomized if omitted.

webhook_url.description: Callback URL for asynchronous processing results.

post.summary: Generate a New Vocal Performance Over an Existing Vocal
post.description: Generates a new vocal performance over a provided vocal track using supplied lyrics, an optional style prompt, and voice controls. The generation process is asynchronous and returns a task ID for tracking.

audio_url.description: Publicly accessible or S3 URL of the vocal audio.

lyrics.description: Lyrics to be sung over the vocal track.

prompt.description: Describe the desired vocal tone, genre, or singing style.
prompt.example: Energetic pop vocal with female singer.

title.description: Optional title for the generated song.

webhook_url.description: Callback URL for asynchronous processing results.

generate_album_cover.description: Whether to generate an album cover for the output.

lyrics_timestamps.description: Whether to generate timestamps for the lyrics. Automatically set to false when make_instrumental is true.

post.summary: Generate a Song from an Image
post.description: Generate a song from an image by analyzing it and creating music based on visual content. The process can optionally include custom lyrics, voice conversion, and various musical parameters.

image_file.description: Image file to upload and analyze. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WEBP.

image_url.description: URL of the image to analyze. Either this or image_file must be provided.

prompt.description: Additional prompt to guide the song generation from the image.
prompt.example: Generate a relaxing acoustic track inspired by this scene.

lyrics.description: Custom lyrics to include in the generated audio.
lyrics.example: Let the colors of the sunset fill your heart.

negative_tags.description: Tags or themes to avoid in the song.
negative_tags.example: no heavy metal, avoid loud drums

make_instrumental.description: Generate instrumental output only. Lyrics will be ignored.

bpm.description: Beats per minute for the song tempo. Defaults to 0 (auto-selected).

webhook_url.description: Optional callback URL for async processing results.

voice_id.description: Voice ID for converting the generated audio. Cannot be used with vocal_only mode.

x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

url = "https://api.wav.com/api/public/v1/image_to_song"

    "key": "C major",
    "bpm": 120,
    "webhook_url": "https://example.com/webhook",
    "voice_id": "voice_123"
}

# Option 1: Using image URL

print(response.json())

# Option 2: Uploading a local image file
# with open("image.png", "rb") as f:
#     files = {"image_file": f}
#     response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=data, files=files)
